Jin logon ne kufr kiya aur logon ko raah-e-Khuda se roka, Khuda ne un ke aamaal ko barbaad kar diya

Aur jin logon ne imaan ikhtiyaar kiya aur nek aamaal kiye, aur jo kuch Muhammad par naazil kiya gaya hai aur Parwardigar ki taraf se barhaq bhi hai us par imaan le aaye, to Khuda ne un ki buraaiyon ko door kar diya aur un ke haalaat ki islaah kar di

Yeh is liye ke kuffaar ne baatil ka ittibaa' kiya hai aur saahibaan-e-imaan ne apne Parwardigar ki taraf se aane waale haq ka ittibaa' kiya hai, aur Khuda isi tarah logon ke liye misaalein bayaan karta hai

Pas jab kuffaar se muqaabla ho to un ki gardanein uda do, yahaan tak ke jab zakhmon se choor ho jaayein to un ki mushkein baandh lo. Phir us ke baad chaahe ehsaan kar ke chhod diya jaaye ya fidya le liya jaaye, yahaan tak ke jang apne hathiyaar rakh de. Yeh yaad rakhna, aur agar Khuda chaahta to khud hi un se badla le leta, lekin woh ek ko doosre ke zariye aazmaana chaahta hai. Aur jo log us ki raah mein qatl hue woh un ke aamaal ko zaaya nahin kar sakta hai
Woh anqareeb inhein manzil tak pahuncha dega aur un ki haalat sanwaar dega
Woh inhein us Jannat mein daakhil karega jo inhein pehle se pehchanwa chuka hai
Imaan waalo! Agar tum Allah ki madad karoge to Allah bhi tumhaari madad karega aur tumhein saabit-qadam bana dega
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un ke waaste dagmagaahat hai aur un ke aamaal barbaad hain
Yeh is liye ke unhon ne Khuda ke naazil kiye hue ahkaam ko bura samjha to Khuda ne bhi un ke aamaal ko zaaya kar diya

To kya un logon ne zameen mein sair nahin ki hai ke dekhte ke un se pehle waalon ka kya anjaam hua hai? Beshak Allah ne inhein tabaah o barbaad kar diya hai, aur kuffaar ke liye bilkul aisi hi saza muqarrar hai
Yeh sab is liye hai ke Allah saahibaan-e-imaan ka Maula aur sarparast hai, aur kaafiron ka koi pursaan-e-haal nahin hai

Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal anjaam diye Khuda inhein aise baaghaat mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya woh maze kar rahe hain aur isi tarah kha rahe hain jis tarah jaanwar khaate hain, aur un ka aakhri thikaana Jahannam hi hai
Aur kitni hi bastiyaan thin jo tumhaari is basti se kahin zyaada taaqatwar thin jis ne tumhein nikaal diya hai. Jab hum ne inhein halaak kar diya to koi madad karne waala bhi na paida hua

To kya jis ke paas Parwardigar ki taraf se khuli hui daleel maujood hai woh us ke misl ho sakta hai jis ke liye us ke badtareen aamaal sanwaar diye gaye hain, aur phir un logon ne apni khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar liya hai

Us Jannat ki sifat jis ka saahibaan-e-taqwa se waada kiya gaya hai yeh hai ke us mein aise paani ki nahrein hain jis mein kisi tarah ki boo nahin hai, aur kuch nahrein doodh ki bhi hain jin ka maza badalta hi nahin hai, aur kuch nahrein sharaab ki bhi hain jin mein peene waalon ke liye lazzat hai, aur kuch nahrein saaf o shaffaaf shahad ki hain, aur un ke liye har tarah ke meve bhi hain aur Parwardigar ki taraf se maghfirat bhi hai. To kya yeh muttaqi afraad un ke jaise ho sakte hain jo hamesha Jahannam mein rehne waale hain, aur jinhein garma-garam paani pilaaya jaaega jis se aantein tukde tukde ho jaayengi

Aur un mein se kuch afraad aise bhi hain jo aap ki baatein ba-zaahir ghaur se sunte hain, us ke baad jab aap ke paas se baahar nikalte hain to jin logon ko ilm diya gaya hai un se kehte hain ke unhon ne abhi kya kaha tha. Yahi woh log hain jin ke dilon par Khuda ne mohr laga di hai aur unhon ne apni khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar liya hai
Aur jin logon ne hidaayat haasil kar li Khuda ne un ki hidaayat mein izaafa kar diya aur un ko mazeed taqwa inaayat farma diya
Phir kya yeh log qiyaamat ka intezaar kar rahe hain ke woh achaanak un ke paas aa jaaye, jab ke us ki alaamatein zaahir ho gayi hain? To agar woh aa bhi gayi to yeh kya naseehat haasil karenge
To yeh samajh lo ke Allah ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur apne aur imaandaar mardon aur auraton ke liye istighfaar karte raho, ke Allah tumhaare chalne phirne aur thehrne se khoob baakhabar hai

Aur jo log imaan le aaye hain woh yeh kehte hain ke aakhir jihaad ke baare mein soora kyon nahin naazil hota. Aur jab soora naazil ho gaya aur us mein jihaad ka zikr kar diya gaya to aap ne dekha ke jin ke dilon mein maraz tha woh aap ki taraf is tarah dekhte reh gaye jaise maut ki si ghashi taari ho gayi ho, to un ke waaste wail aur afsos hai
Un ke haq mein behtareen baat itaa'at aur nek guftugu hai. Phir jab jang ka mu'aamla tai ho jaaye to agar Khuda se apne kiye waade par qaaim rahein to un ke haq mein bahut behtar hai
To kya tum se kuch ba'eed hai ke tum saahib-e-iqtidaar ban jaao to zameen mein fasaad barpa karo aur qaraabat-daaron se qat'-e-ta'alluqaat kar lo
Yahi woh log hain jin par Khuda ne la'nat ki hai aur un ke kaanon ko behra kar diya hai aur un ki aankhon ko andha bana diya hai
To kya yeh log Quran mein zara bhi ghaur nahin karte hain ya un ke dilon par qufl pade hue hain
Beshak jo log hidaayat ke waazeh ho jaane ke baad ulte paaon palat gaye, Shaitaan ne un ki khwaahishaat ko aaraasta kar diya hai aur inhein khoob dheel de di hai

Yeh is liye ke un logon ne Khuda ki naazil ki hui baaton ko naapasand karne waalon se yeh kaha ke hum ba'z masaail mein tumhaari hi itaa'at karenge, aur Allah un ki raaz ki baaton se khoob baakhabar hai
Phir us waqt kya hoga jab malaaika inhein duniya se uthaayenge aur un ke chehron aur pusht par musalsal maarte jaayenge
Yeh is liye ke unhon ne un baaton ka ittibaa' kiya hai jo Khuda ko naaraaz karne waali hain aur us ki marzi ko naapasand kiya hai, to Khuda ne bhi un ke aamaal ko barbaad kar ke rakh diya hai
Kya jin logon ke dilon mein beemaari paayi jaati hai un ka khayaal yeh hai ke Khuda un ke dilon ke keenon ko baahar nahin laaega
Aur hum chaahte to inhein dikhla dete aur aap chehre ke aasaar hi se pehchaan lete, aur un ki guftugu ke andaaz se to bahar-haal pehchaan hi lenge, aur Allah tum sab ke aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Aur hum yaqeenan tum sab ka imtehaan lenge taake yeh dekhein ke tum mein jihaad karne waale aur sabr karne waale kaun log hain, aur is tarah tumhaare haalaat ko baa-qaa'ida jaanch lein

Beshak jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya aur logon ko Khuda ki raah se roka, aur hidaayat ke waazeh ho jaane ke baad bhi Paighambar se jhagda kiya, woh Allah ko koi nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakte hain, aur Allah anqareeb un ke aamaal ko bilkul barbaad kar dega
Imaan waalo! Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo, aur khabardaar apne aamaal ko barbaad na karo
Beshak jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur Khuda ki raah mein rukaawat daali aur phir haalat-e-kufr hi mein mar gaye to Khuda inhein hargiz maaf nahin karega
Lihaaza tum himmat na haaro aur dushman ko sulah ki daawat na do, aur tum sar-buland ho aur Allah tumhaare saath hai, aur woh hargiz tumhaare aamaal ke sawaab ko kam nahin karega
Yeh zindagaani-e-duniya to sirf ek khel tamaasha hai, aur agar tum ne imaan aur taqwa ikhtiyaar kar liya to Khuda tumhein mukammal ajr ata karega aur tum se tumhaara maal talab nahin karega
Woh agar talab bhi kare aur israar bhi kare to tum bukhl hi karoge, aur Khuda tumhaare keenon ko khud hi zaahir kar dega

Haan haan, tum wahi log ho jinhein raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karne ke liye bulaaya jaata hai to tum mein se ba'z log bukhl karne lagte hain, aur jo log bukhl karte hain woh apne hi haq mein bukhl karte hain. Aur Khuda sab se be-niyaaz hai, tum hi sab us ke faqeer aur muhtaaj ho, aur agar tum munh pher loge to woh tumhaare badle doosri qaum ko le aaega jo us ke baad tum jaise na honge
